title: Assistant Principal/Senior Civil Engineer (Treatment Plant)
description:
Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future. 
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that s defining our future. It s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support. 
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be brilliant . 
Job Purpose To provide technical leadership in the planning, design, and delivery of civil and hydraulic engineering solutions for water and wastewater treatment projects. The role is responsible for leading hydraulic design activities, assuring technical quality, coordinating multidisciplinary interfaces, managing technical risk, and supporting successful project delivery across all project stages. Roles and Responsibilities
 
 Technical Leadership Design Delivery Lead civil and hydraulic engineering design for water and wastewater treatment works and associated infrastructure. Take technical responsibility for hydraulic design elements including treatment plant hydraulics, pumping systems, pipelines, channels, tanks, chambers and flow control structures. Develop and review hydraulic profiles, headloss assessments, flow balancing and system performance evaluations. Prepare, review and approve design calculations, technical reports, specifications and drawings. Support feasibility studies, optioneering, outline design, detailed design and construction support activities. Ensure compliance with client requirements, applicable standards, health and safety obligations and internal quality procedures.
 
 Multidisciplinary Coordination Project Delivery Coordinate with process, mechanical, electrical, ICA, structural and geotechnical disciplines to ensure integrated design solutions. Identify, manage and communicate technical risks, assumptions, constraints and interfaces. Support design reviews, hazard reviews, value engineering and technical assurance processes. Provide technical support during construction, commissioning and issue resolution activities. Apply safe-by-design principles in all engineering activities. Contribute to risk identification, mitigation and continuous improvement initiatives.
 
 Client Business Support Contribute to bid submissions, proposals and client-facing technical discussions. Support client engagement, technical assurance and project delivery performance. Contribute to business development activities and proposal development. Travel to project offices and sites as required.
 
 Team Leadership Capability Development Mentor and guide junior engineers and designers. Provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary project teams. Promote knowledge sharing, innovation and continuous improvement within the discipline. Support the growth of technical capability and engineering best practices across the business. Candidate Specifications
 Qualifications Essential Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Masters degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering. Desirable Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards chartership with a recognised professional institution.
 
 Experience Essential Significant experience in civil and hydraulic engineering design for water and wastewater treatment projects. Demonstrable experience leading technical delivery on multidisciplinary engineering projects. Experience preparing and reviewing high-quality engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications and design documentation. Desirable Experience delivering major treatment works or complex water-sector programmes. Experience in design management, project planning and resource coordination. Experience supporting construction-stage activities and contractor engagement.
 
 Technical Knowledge Skills Essential Strong understanding of treatment works hydraulics and associated civil infrastructure. Good knowledge of relevant industry standards, codes and engineering design practices. Ability to manage technical complexity, competing priorities and project deadlines. Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills. Desirable Familiarity with hydraulic modelling tools and specialist engineering software. Knowledge of digital engineering, BIM and design collaboration platforms.
 
 Key Competencies Technical leadership Engineering judgement and decision making Collaboration and multidisciplinary coordination Quality and risk management Client focus and stakeholder engagement Communication and influencing skills Planning and delivery focus Coaching and mentoring Flexible working 
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage. Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience: Agile working Critical illness and compassionate leave Paternity Leave Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage Career mobility options Short and Long-term global employment opportunities Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Mining & Wrangling
description:
Key Responsibilities :

- Understand the factories , manufacturing process , data availability and avenues for improvement

- Brainstorm , together with engineering, manufacturing and quality problems that can be solved using the acquired data in the data lake platform.

- Define what data is required to create a solution and work with connectivity engineers , users to collect the data

- Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture.

- Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements.

- Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery for greater scalability

- Work on data preparation, data deep dive , help engineering, process and quality to understand the process/ machine behavior more closely using available data

- Deploy and monitor the solution

- Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.

- Work together with Data Architects and data modeling teams.

 Skills /Competencies :

- Good knowledge of the business vertical with prior experience in solving different use cases in the manufacturing or similar industry

- Ability to bring cross industry learning to benefit the use cases aimed at improving manufacturing process

Problem Scoping/definition Skills :

- Experience in problem scoping, solving, quantification

- Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.

- Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management.

- Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable 'big data' data stores

- Ability to foresee and identify all right data required to solve the problem

Data Wrangling Skills :

- Strong skill in data mining, data wrangling techniques for creating the required analytical dataset

- Experience building and optimizing 'big data' data pipelines, architectures and data sets

- Adaptive mindset to improvise on the data challenges and employ techniques to drive desired outcomes

Programming Skills :

- Experience with big data tools: Spark, Delta, CDC, NiFi, Kafka, etc

- Experience with relational SQL ,NoSQL databases and query languages, including oracle , Hive, sparkQL.

- Experience with object-oriented languages: Scala, Java, C++ etc.

Visualization Skills :

- Know how of any visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau

- Good storytelling skills to present the data in simple and meaningful manner

Data Engineering Skills :

- Strong skill in data analysis techniques to generate finding and insights by means of exploratory data analysis

- Good understanding of how to transform and connect the data of various types and form

- Great numerical and analytical skills

- Identify opportunities for data acquisition

- Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability

- Build algorithms and prototypes

- Reformulating existing frameworks to optimize their functioning.

- Good understanding of optimization techniques to make the system performant for requirements.

Key Skills: Data Engineering,Data Mining,Java,NoSQL,Data Wrangling,Scala,Big Data,Data Visualization
